text:
maya: Heads up — my feature branch feature/prefetch-2026 just went red in CI after I rebased on main. Integration job hangs on staging. Can someone take a quick look? CI run: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/98765 :pray:

ci-bot: Build 98765 — FAILED — tests/inference/test_streaming.py::test_partial_flush (job: integrate-staging-12). Last log chunk: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/98765/logs (hang at 30s idle)

alex: @maya I'll try a quick rerun first. usually flakes or ephemeral infra.

alex: kicking off rerun -> 98765-rerun1 :gear:

ci-bot: Rerun 98765-rerun1 — STILL HANGS at tests/inference/test_streaming.py::test_partial_flush (30s). Same stack trace region.

chen: Can you paste the small diff you rebased? Any runtime or batching changes?

maya: it's tiny — prefetch path + bumped tokenizers. Diff snippet:
```
+ def _maybe_prefetch(inputs):
+     if PREFETCH_STRICT:
+         prefetch.kv_prefetch(inputs)
+     else:
+         # fallback: best-effort prefetch
+         prefetch.try_prefetch(inputs)
```

maya: full patch is on my branch if anyone wants to glance: git remote:feature/prefetch-2026

chen: hmm, the failure output looks like the streaming flush never fired after a partial chunk. Could be interaction between KV caching and streaming scheduler. Paste of failing assert:
```
==================== FAILURES ====================
tests/inference/test_streaming.py::test_partial_flush
  AssertionError: expected flush count 2 but got 1
  runtime/streaming.py: send_partial() not called after commit 3fa2c9
  Trace: File ".../runtime/streaming.py", line 214, in _process_chunk
```

sanjay: I can take a git bisect if we need to find the offending commit. @maya are you okay with me running bisect on your branch + main?

maya: yes please, that'd be huge. I can repro locally but bisect will be faster.

olivia: quick workaround to unblock CI: set PREFETCH_STRICT=false in env for the integration job. That bypasses the strict prefetch path. Not a fix but should let downstream PRs land.

maya: trying that now — pushing patch to CI config to flip PREFETCH_STRICT=false for integrate-staging job.

ci-bot: New build 98765-patch1 with PREFETCH_STRICT=false — PASSED all tests (including test_partial_flush). Logs: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/98765-patch1/logs :relieved:

maya: Nice. I'll open a follow-up PR with a proper test fix and revert once we find root cause.

alex: please also add a regression unit that asserts flush count on the streaming harness. Happy to review CR. :+1:

chen: Sanjay — if you can bisect, start from main@3f8a..feature/prefetch-2026 and ping here with the first bad commit. I suspect the tokenizer bump is a red herring but worth checking.

sanjay: Will run bisect now and report back in this thread. ETA ~30m.

maya: thanks all. tagging @eng-oncall in case this crops up on other branches. :eyes:

olivia: filing a quick issue to track (internal): https://go/redwood/issue/1423 — include CI links and temp workaround.

sanjay: quick update — bisect narrowed it down to commit 3fa2c9e which changed streaming scheduler order when prefetch raises. Repro locally.

maya: that matches the earlier stack note. I'll push a small fix to ensure send_partial is invoked even if prefetch throws.

alex: awesome. once you have a patch, mark it WIP and @mention me for quick review.

maya: pushed fix branch feature/prefetch-2026-fix. Running CI.

ci-bot: Build 98765-fix1 — PASSED.

maya: merging the fix to my branch then will open PR against main with tests. thanks everyone :tada:

alex: great triage. closing loop when PR is up.

chen: noted for postmortem: add a streaming regression case to the nightly e2e matrix.

sanjay: final note: no further bisect needed, marking bisect done in the issue.
